scope: Fictional local PERM disclosures + real Daily Scan and official Career-Ops writers in disposable workspaces
failure_modes: Disabled or absent PERM history setting still snapshots local data, requires company research, writes references or changes work authorization
Non-boolean PERM history settings silently enable research, or changing the live switch reinterprets an already frozen run
Automatic company review changes scoring inputs, old baselines/reports, unrelated aliases or the frozen disclosure revision
Missing/partial review silently skips unmatched scored employers, or ambiguous identities are published without asking the user
Research source failures prevent otherwise valid scan persistence, or post-review registry/evidence edits change the frozen result
An unverified, posting-only or unrelated alias is accepted as an automatic company-history update
A company-history reference implies the current posting legal employer is verified or works only for the preview posting
Reference data changes assignments, scores, hard exclusions, decisions or reporting threshold
Low-score or hard-excluded evaluated postings lack reference information
Aliases extend beyond verified posting key and URL or combine unrelated legal entities
Missing cache or Python blocks otherwise valid scoring
Current pointer, aliases or evidence refresh silently changes an in-progress run
Frozen manifest, result artifact, posting binding or report summary drifts without detection
Reference appears outside Work Authorization, duplicates, swallows model prose or bypasses compact body budget
Report expansion loses or rewrites Work Authorization/reference, duplicates it in the appendix or changes Machine Summary
Resumed legacy baselines are silently reinterpreted as the new body layout
Report links break when current aliases change or assume every job has a report
Repeated commit/audit overwrites old reports, reads live current state or introduces SHA-256
acceptance: PERM history defaults off in active, fixture and public example configuration; explicit opt-in retains the existing complete reference workflow
Disabled runs commit without PERM snapshots, review requirements or reference artifacts, even after the live setting is enabled; enabled frozen runs finish after it is disabled
Evidence-backed company-history aliases work for different exact postings while preserving original work authorization and explicitly leaving posting legal employer unconfirmed
Baseline freezes immutable dataset revision, alias registry and exact quoted evidence
Worker assignments and merged result payloads exclude PERM data
All evaluated postings have one exact posting key/URL binding, including low-score and hard exclusions
New baselines freeze work-authorization-v1, including unavailable snapshots; old baselines retain metadata layout

Formal reports preserve the original Work Authorization text, then append exactly one nested reference with annual counts, duration quantiles/sample sizes, recent dates, dimension summaries, sources and caveats
PERM outcome table has three columns so all statuses remain readable without changing upstream wide-grid CSS
Absent, ambiguous, scope-mismatched and unavailable results never pretend zero applications
A changed artifact rejects before Career-Ops writes; receipt audits report summaries and scored coverage
Compact parsing preserves original scoring-body limits; malformed, moved, duplicated and forged references are rejected
Expansion and explicit repair retain the frozen reference exactly once and preserve original authorization; legacy header references stay unchanged
Official tracker/history conservation and all previous report bytes remain unchanged
